Firerate does not account for projectile travel time.
DPS assumes only one enemy is hit and receives full splash damage, and does not account for projectile travel time.
With burn, Total DPS is calculated as Normal DPS + Burn DPS, with Burn DPS being calculated as Burn Damage ÷ Tick.
